name: PORTRAIT & EVENT PHOTOGRAPHY
body:
## 1. BOOKING, PAYMENTS & FEES
 
### 1.1 Booking & Deposits
 
A 30% non-refundable deposit is required to secure your booking.
 
Your booking is confirmed only once both:
 
- The deposit is paid, and
- The signed contract has been received.
 
The remaining balance must be paid no later than 24 hours after the scheduled photoshoot or event.
 
The deposit becomes non-refundable in all cases where:
 
- The client behaves disrespectfully, aggressively or inappropriately toward the photographer, assistants, venue staff or any third party.
- The client violates any agreements listed in this contract before, during or after the shoot.
- The photographer is forced to leave the shoot for safety or misconduct reasons.
- The client cancels or reschedules a studio portrait session with less than five (5) working days’ notice (deposit is retained and not transferable).
- If the Client cancels or reschedules all other shoots less than 48 hours before the scheduled start time.
 
### 1.2 Overdue Payments
 
Invoices not paid within 7 days of the due date incur 5% interest per day.
 
Posting images online or using them for promotional purposes before full payment is received will result in an additional 10% daily fee until the outstanding balance is fully settled.
 
### 1.3 Client Communication Requirements
 
Clear communication is essential for your shoot to run smoothly. If the Client fails to respond to messages, requests, or approval-related communication leading up to the shoot - particularly regarding scheduling, studio bookings, or essential details - the Photographer reserves the right to cancel the session.
 
If communication has not been received by the day before the shoot, or if studio arrangements cannot be finalised due to lack of response, the Photographer may cancel the booking and the deposit will be retained.
 
### 1.4 Payment Methods
 
Payment may be made via cash, bank transfer, approved payment card, or any other method authorised by the Business.
 
### 1.5 Invoices
 
The Business will invoice the Client for a deposit before the project begins, and again after completion of the project or agreed milestones. Failure to pay invoices by the required date may result in suspension or termination of services.
 
### 1.6 Cooling-Off Rights
 
Under UK Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013:
 
- You may cancel within 14 days of signing this contract, unless the photographic services have already been completed.
- If services have started but not finished, you must pay for work completed up to the cancellation date.
 
## 2. CANCELLATIONS, RESCHEDULING & LATENESS
 
### 2.1 Client Cancellations
 
- Cancellations made within 24 hours of the shoot will be charged in full.
- Deposits are strictly non-refundable.
- Studio portrait sessions cancelled with less than five working days’ notice will result in the deposit being retained.
 
### 2.2 Rescheduling
 
- Must be requested at least 48 hours in advance.
- Subject to availability.
- Additional studio or travel fees may apply for rescheduled sessions.
 
### 2.3 Photographer Cancellations
 
If the Photographer must cancel due to illness, emergency, or circumstances beyond control, the Client may choose:
 
- a full refund, or
- a rescheduled date at no additional charge.
 
### 2.4 Lateness
 
Arriving 30 minutes late without notice results in cancellation and forfeiture of payment.
 
For studio shoots, lost time due to lateness is deducted from the session time. Additional studio hours cannot be purchased on the day.
 
### 2.5 Guests at Shoots
 
Clients may bring up to two guests, but only with prior notice and approval.
 
No advance notice = no guests permitted.
 
## 3. DELIVERABLES
 
### 3.1 Delivery Timeline
 
- Portraits & events: 2–7 working days
- Weddings, edited images: up to 2 weeks
- Weddings, hardback wedding book (if included): up to 4 weeks
- Expedited 24-hour turnaround available for an additional fee (portrait sessions only).
 
### 3.2 Delivery Method
 
All images are delivered via a private, password-protected online gallery.
 
## 4. EDITING, IMAGE RIGHTS & USAGE
 
### 4.1 RAW Files
 
The Photographer does not provide RAW or unedited files under any circumstance. RAW files are considered incomplete work and withheld to preserve quality and artistic integrity.
 
### 4.2 Editing Style
 
Clients receive fully edited, high-resolution images in the Photographer’s established style.
 
Additional editing requests outside the agreed package will incur extra fees.
 
### 4.3 Copyright
 
All images remain the intellectual property of Liora Creative Studio.
 
Clients receive a personal use licence only (print, share, personal social media).
 
Commercial or promotional use requires written permission and may incur licensing fees.
 
### 4.4 Social Media Tagging
 
If a client heavily edits, filters, or alters an image to the point where it no longer reflects the Photographer’s work:
 
- They must not tag Liora Creative Studio.
- The Photographer may request removal of attribution to protect brand integrity.
 
### 4.5 Photographer Promotion Rights
 
Liora Creative Studio may use selected images for portfolio, website, marketing, or social media purposes unless the Client opts out in writing before the shoot.
 
## 5. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES
 
### 5.1 Permissions & Permits
 
Clients are responsible for obtaining all permissions required for the chosen location (venues, public spaces, private property).
 
The Photographer is not liable for restrictions or delays imposed by third parties.
 
### 5.2 Conduct
 
Clients must behave respectfully and safely during sessions. Abusive behaviour may result in immediate termination of the session with no refund provided.
 
### 5.3 Laser Event Coverage
 
The Client understands that laser lights can permanently damage camera sensors.
 
If a DJ or lighting technician uses laser lights, the Client is responsible for ensuring that lasers are turned off or pointed away from the dance floor for the duration of photography coverage. This request is solely for equipment protection and does not reflect on the event or staff involved.
 
For concerts or venues using laser rigs, the Client must inform the Photographer at least 24 hours in advance where lasers will be directed. Failure to provide this information may void liability for damaged images or missed coverage.
 
If the Client or their vendors fail to follow these requirements, including refusing to turn or redirect lasers, and damage occurs to the Photographer’s equipment as a result, the Client agrees to be financially responsible for:
 
- Full cost of sensor replacement
- Full cost of lens repair or replacement, where applicable
- Any reasonable associated repair fees or diagnostic charges
 
The Photographer will attach receipts or repair quotes to the invoice to document the costs.
 
## 6. LIABILITY
 
### 6.1 General Liability
 
The Photographer is not liable for delays or issues caused from:
 
- weather conditions
- venue restrictions
- late arrivals
- delays caused by traffic or public transport
- loss of photos due to client error (lost downloads, deleted files, etc.)
 
### 6.2 Equipment Failure or Emergencies
 
In the unlikely event of technical failure, accident, or unforeseen circumstances preventing completion of the shoot:
 
The photographer’s liability is limited to a reshoot or refund equal to the amount paid.
 
### 6.3 Event Coverage Liability
 
For weddings and significant events, Liora Creative Studio is not liable for missed key moments caused by guests or attendees stepping into the Photographer’s line of sight (e.g., guests blocking the aisle, holding up phones, or obstructing the lens).
 
The Client agrees that such interference is outside the Photographer’s control and cannot be grounds for complaint or compensation.
 
## 7. CLIENT SATISFACTION & REFUND POLICY
 
### 7.1 General Liability
 
The Photographer is not liable for delays or issues caused by:
 
- weather conditions
- venue restrictions
- late arrivals
- delays caused by traffic or public transport
- loss of photos due to client error (lost downloads, deleted files, etc.)
 
### 7.2 Loss of Usage Rights
 
If a refund is issued, the Client immediately forfeits their personal-use, commercial-use or promotional-use licence for all images delivered.
 
The Client may not post, use, print, edit, share, or publish any of the images once a refund has been processed.
 
If the Client uses images after receiving a refund, the photographer will provide documentation (screenshots, links, etc.) showing image use, and will reserve the right to invoice the Client for the full original package amount.
 
The invoice issued under this clause must be paid in full within 48 hours of issue.
 
Late payment may result in interest charges, late fees, and/or further recovery action consistent with the studio's general invoice terms.
 
## 8. EXPENSES
 
The Client agrees to reimburse the Photographer for any reasonable expenses required for the shoot, including:
 
- travel outside included areas
- additional studio hire (outside of agreed booking period)
- props
- entry fees or location permits
- accommodation (for destination events)
 
These will be communicated in advance.
 
## 9. AUTHORITY TO SIGN
 
Both parties confirm they have full legal authority to enter this agreement and fulfil the obligations set out herein.
 
## 10. MODIFICATIONS
 
Any amendments to this agreement must be made in writing and signed by both the Client and the Photographer.
 
## 11. LICENSING AND LEGAL COMPLIANCE
 
The Photographer confirms they hold all licenses, qualifications, and permissions necessary to provide the services described.
 
## 12. GOVERNING LAW
 
This agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.

name: GRAPHIC DESIGN
body:
## 1. SCOPE OF WORK
 
The Designer agrees to provide graphic design services as outlined in the agreed proposal, invoice, or written correspondence. Services may include, but are not limited to:
 
- Wedding stationery (e.g. invitations, save-the-dates, signage, menus, seating charts)
- Custom posters and artwork
- Printed materials (e.g. brochures, flyers, programs, signage)
- Digital-ready or print-ready design files
 
Each project includes one initial design concept unless otherwise stated, and a defined number of revisions as agreed in writing.
 
Any work requested outside the agreed scope — including additional concepts, revisions, formats, reprints, or rush requests — will be quoted and charged separately.
 
## 2. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES
 
The Client agrees to:
 
- Provide all required content (text, images, logos, wording, sizes, quantities, and preferences) in a timely manner
- Ensure all supplied content is accurate, spell-checked, and legally permitted for use
- Review proofs carefully and provide clear feedback within the agreed timeframe
 
The Designer is not responsible for errors that appear in final designs after written approval has been given.
 
## 3. TIMELINES & DELAYS
 
Design timelines are estimates and depend on:
 
- Timely delivery of content
- Prompt feedback and approvals
- Scope stability throughout the project
 
Delays caused by the client may result in adjusted delivery dates. The Designer is not responsible for missed deadlines caused by delayed feedback, late content, or last-minute changes.
 
## 4. REVISIONS & PROOFING
 
Unless otherwise stated, projects include up to three (3) rounds of revisions.
 
A revision is defined as a reasonable change to existing design elements, not a new concept.
 
Once final approval is given:
 
- No further changes are included
- Any amendments will be billed separately
- The Designer is not liable for errors that were present in approved proofs
 
## 5. PAYMENT TERMS
 
### 5.1 Paid Projects
 
- A 50% non-refundable deposit is required before work begins
- The remaining balance is due upon completion and before final files or print release
- Final files will not be supplied until full payment is received
 
Late payments may incur interest at 5% per day overdue and may delay delivery.
 
### 5.2 Exposure / Credit-Based Work
 
Where services are provided in exchange for exposure rather than payment, the Client agrees to provide:
 
- Prominent credit to “Design by LIORA Creative Studio”
- Logo placement where applicable
- At least one social media tag and/or website mention
 
Failure to provide agreed exposure allows the Designer to issue an invoice for the full commercial value of the work.
 
## 6. PRINTING & PRODUCTION
 
Where the Designer arranges or advises on printing:
 
- The Designer is not responsible for printer errors, delays, or third-party production faults
- Slight colour variations may occur between screen proofs and printed materials
- Variations in paper texture, weight, trimming, and finish are industry standard and not considered defects
 
Reprints due to Client-approved errors or late changes will be charged to the Client.
 
## 7. OWNERSHIP, COPYRIGHT & USAGE RIGHTS
 
All designs remain the intellectual property of LIORA Creative Studio unless otherwise agreed in writing.
 
The Client is granted a non-exclusive licence to use the final design solely for the agreed purpose.
 
The Client may not:
- Resell, modify, or redistribute designs
- Use designs for additional events or products
- Remove design credit where included
 
Commercial reuse, reproduction, or adaptation requires written permission and may incur additional licensing fees.
 
## 8. CREDIT & PORTFOLIO USE
 
The Designer retains the right to:
 
- Display completed work in portfolios, on websites, social media, and promotional materials
 
If the Client requires confidentiality (e.g. private weddings), this must be requested in writing before the project begins.
 
## 9. CANCELLATIONS & TERMINATION
 
If the Client cancels after work has commenced:
 
- The deposit is non-refundable
- The Client will be invoiced for work completed to date
 
If the Designer must terminate the project due to inappropriate behaviour, non-payment, or breach of terms, no refund will be issued.
 
## 10. REFUNDS
 
Due to the custom nature of design work:
 
- No refunds are offered once work has commenced
- Approved designs are considered final
 
If a refund is issued at the Designer’s discretion, all usage rights are revoked immediately.
 
## 11. FORCE MAJEURE
 
The Designer is not liable for delays or failure to perform due to events beyond reasonable control, including illness, technical failure, supplier issues, or acts of God.
 
## 12. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
 
The Designer is not liable for:
 
- Indirect or consequential losses
- Print delays, third-party failures, or supplier issues
- Errors approved by the Client
- Losses resulting from use of the design beyond agreed purposes
 
Total liability is limited to the amount paid by the Client for the specific project.

name: BESPOKE TRIP PLANNING
body:
## 1.1 NATURE OF SERVICE
 
Liora Creative Studio provides an itinerary creation service only.
 
The Studio does not book any flights, hotels, accommodation, insurance, or activities on behalf of clients.
 
It is the responsibility of the client to make and confirm all bookings, reservations, and payments directly with the relevant providers.
 
## 1.2 ACCURACY AND AVAILABILITY
 
All prices, activity listings, and recommendations included in itineraries are accurate at the time of creation and have been verified as of October 2025.
 
Prices and availability may fluctuate after purchase. Liora Creative Studio cannot be held responsible for any increases in cost, unavailability, or changes to services made by third-party providers.
 
## 1.3 BESPOKE ITINERARIES
 
Bespoke itineraries are tailored to each client’s travel dates, interests, and preferences.
 
Bookings must be made at least two months before the intended travel date to allow sufficient time for research and planning.
 
Express or short-notice requests (under one month) can be catered to based on availability and incur additional fees.
 
## 1.4 REVISIONS AND AMENDMENTS
 
Each bespoke itinerary includes one complimentary revision within 7 days of delivery.
 
Additional revisions within the same 7-day period incur a £10 research fee per revision.
 
No revisions can be made after 7 days from the date of delivery.
 
## 1.5 LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY
 
Liora Creative Studio is not responsible for:
 
- Cancelled or delayed flights
- Accommodation issues, including false or misleading advertising by hotels or rental hosts
- Cancelled, rescheduled, or unavailable activities
- Poor experiences or unsatisfactory food at restaurants, as recommendations are based on publicly available information and reviews
- Acts of nature, strikes, political unrest, or any event beyond the Studio’s control
 
## 1.6 RECOMMENDATIONS AND DINING
 
All restaurants included in itineraries are chosen based on strong online reviews, popularity, and cultural relevance.
 
Liora Creative Studio cannot guarantee food quality or service standards and does not take responsibility for negative experiences.
 
Clients are strongly encouraged to make restaurant reservations in advance to ensure availability.
 
## 1.7 RESPONSIBILITY OF THE TRAVELLER
 
Clients are solely responsible for ensuring they have valid travel documentation, visas, insurance, and any health or safety requirements relevant to their trip.
 
The Studio is not liable for any losses or damages resulting from incomplete or inaccurate travel documentation.
 
## 1.8 DELIVERABLES
 
Itineraries are delivered digitally in PDF or web-based format within the agreed timeframe.
 
Once delivered, itineraries are for personal use only and may not be reproduced or resold.
